about.en: IBB is the iShares Biotechnology ETF, sponsored by BlackRock, an exchange-traded fund listed on Nasdaq that tracks the NYSE Biotechnology Index of US-listed biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies. Until June 2021 it was named the iShares Nasdaq Biotechnology ETF and tracked the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index, which is why some derivative venues still use the old name. Each share represents an interest in the fund's portfolio.
